    Kronecker bricks of dimension up to 2^|k| #

    Identify the infinite field k with ((k × Bool) × ℕ) ⊕ ℕ. For X ⊆ k the set Λ_X of the points ((a, [a ∈ X]), n) gives pairwise Hom-orthogonal bricks T_{Λ_X} (Λ_X \ Λ_Y is infinite for X ≠ Y), all orthogonal to T_{Λ₀} for the ℕ part Λ₀. Gluing ν ≤ 2^|k| of them over T_{Λ₀} along the explicit non-split extensions gives a brick of dimension max(|k|, ν) (exists_brick_of_le_two_pow). So Göbel–Simson's Corollary 1.3 is proved for κ ≤ 2^|k|.
